column1: Welcome to the Pain Regulation Task!
Please relax and remain still during the experiment while we record your brain activity.

In this task, you will read a brief script and form the mental images it describes.

Your role is simply to engage with the imagery as instructed.

You will complete the imagery task and a confidence rating five times before moving on.
There will be a 30 second break between each regulation technique section.
The state measure will begin on the following screen.\n\nPlease let us know if you have any remaining questions.
